summary: A canvasser asks whether the person on the list is the one at the door before saying anything else.
realLife: A volunteer guide opens with a request for the voter by name and says answers from anyone else are never logged as the voter's.
sources: Commons Library, Tools roundup: canvassing and door knocking, undated: https://commonslibrary.org/tools-roundup-canvassing-and-door-knocking/
inGame: walk list entry with the listed voter's name; household members from the home record

turns.turn: The listed voter is the one who opened
turns.writesBack: the pitch goes on with the voter's own record

turns.turn: Someone else answers and the voter is out
turns.writesBack: the list entry is marked not home, with a note of who spoke
